scope:
Configured PMTU-ceiling diagnostic, same binary and fixed receive capacity.

Not an official ranking or proof of actual validated PMTU. Eighteen serial rounds:
three matched blocks/profile with balanced 1472/4096/8192 order. Every server uses
receive limit 8192 and GSO=1; only send discovery ceiling varies. Preserve the
existing probe step/1ms interval. Requires a new source snapshot and allocator
proof for the actual candidate binary, with CNETMOD_USE_MIMALLOC=OFF.
Timed policy: done==succeeded>0, 2xx>=done, zero failed/errored/timeout/non2xx;
header-only delta is not completed throughput. No long-retention claim.
Run via the isolated mount/gai wrapper in the coordinator's serial window.
